correctness.rationale: For labeled C_n Cartesian K_2, projected connectivity forces occupied columns into a cyclic interval when an empty column exists; domination forbids three empty columns. One empty/no double is impossible; two empty columns require two boundary doubles, giving the sharp lower bound |S|>=n for n>=4. Equality d=z leaves exactly three structurally exhaustive cases whose multiplicities are 2, 2n(n-1), and 2n (four rather than 2n at n=4), with an independent n=3 rung exception. Both directions, disjointness and tree/cycle induced types are proved in RESULT.md. Direct exhaustive graph checking of 1,398,072 nonempty subsets for n=3..10, plus 43,570 larger structural constructions, agrees, without being used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An explicit motivated infinite-family classification of every optimal connected dominating backbone in a canonical cubic graph. The refined polynomial distinguishes geometric double-column structure beyond a known scalar optimum and determines exactly two cycle-induced configurations against 2n^2 tree-induced configurations for n>=5, with sharp n=3 and n=4 exceptional behavior. This is a natural exact extremal multiplicity classification, not a routine parameter substitution or standalone integer-sequence observation.
